judgedAgainst: page-sheet.json and coreModel, then rendered at 390px and 1280px in local Vite

questions.teachesOrExplains: The page demonstrates a sample and asks the reader to inspect and record their own host. The check transfers the bind-address model to another port.
questions.coreModel: The carry-away sentence forced the order: bind scope first, port second; every reach claim is conditional on firewall and routing.
questions.scope: No other-device scan or service change. UDP is distinguished from TCP LISTEN. The two-entry worksheet is a start, not a claim of complete inventory.

findings.finding: At 390px the original three-column worked-inventory table hid the purpose and next check off-screen, although those are part of the sheet's outcome.
findings.change: Reduced to two columns and put reach with next check; all parts visible on phone.

findings.finding: A single three-OS code block was long and hard to navigate on a phone. On desktop its Windows lines remained wide.
findings.change: Split into three labeled OS-specific code blocks; shortened Windows commands so each line fits at 390px.

findings.finding: The first synthetic example line was long enough to force horizontal scrolling at phone width.
findings.change: Shortened the invented process labels and removed a redundant comment while keeping protocol, address, port, and process.

findings.finding: The figure caption said arrows show bind scope, but the figure has labeled regions, no arrows.
findings.change: Caption now says labels; SVG and alt checked for conditional reach.

findings.finding: The Windows command originally selected a long list of fields that overflowed at phone width.
findings.change: Shortened the command; the surrounding text explains where to find OwningProcess and how to resolve a PID.

findings.finding: The sheet says list every listener, but two fill-in entries alone could be mistaken for completion.
findings.change: Called it a start, then instructs the reader to continue the private dated inventory until the rest of the machine's listeners are accounted for.

findings.finding: Initial wording blurred UDP endpoints with TCP listeners and implied all UDP listings were listening.
findings.change: States UDP has no LISTEN state and may include other sockets.

visualCheck.phone: 390px: inspected top, figure, example, table, each OS command, check, fill-in and closing at actual pixels. Table and commands are readable without losing a needed column; code stays optionally horizontally scrollable by renderer.
visualCheck.desktop: 1280px: inspected top, figure, example, commands and fill-in at actual pixels. No clipping or unintended layering observed.
visualCheck.limitation: Local renderer check; preview deployment not yet reviewed by Chris. No interactive form submission or assistive-technology audit.

accepted: A single bind-address model leads the page
a worked inventory and transfer check
temporary inputs explicitly distinguished from a saved record
caveat: Sheet, generation, and critique are by the same author; independent review is still needed.
